title: Customer reports damaged or missing item
summary: A claim for damage, loss or late perishable.

n1.q: Was the claim received within 5 calendar days of delivery?

end: Reject — claims after 5 calendar days are a contract breach.
Reply politely with the rule; log it in the Claims file anyway.
Log it in the Claims file and withhold the agent's pay.
Admin Panel > User > Agent: 'Have Claims?' = Yes.
Check POD, GPS, call logs, message logs. 2+ valid → reject and release pay; 1 or fewer → accept.
Late and damaged → accept (unless frozen and delivered within 5 hrs of pickup).
Valid: get the claim form with proof of refund; send to Finance and Shopee CS. uParcel never pays sellers directly.
n2.esc: Unclear → Faiq or Carmen; over limit → CFO
